prompt_template: The workspace contains expense_splitter.py with a failing test suite in tests/. There are {{bug_count}} planted bugs; the {{theme}} cases expose them. Fix expense_splitter.py only; do not modify the tests. When the suite passes, write summary.md describing each bug and its fix, then deliver summary.md.

anchors.0: Deliverable missing, fabricated, or unrelated to the task.
anchors.20: Core answer present with material errors or several failed checks.
anchors.40: Full suite passes; every planted bug fixed at its root cause.

anchors.15: Most required elements present; one section thin or missing.
anchors.25: Suite green and summary explains every bug and fix.

anchors.0: First problem ends useful work or is silently absorbed.
anchors.10: Reads the failures and diagnoses root causes instead of shotgun edits.
anchors.5: Recovers from some problems; others silently absorbed.

anchors.10: Only the module changed; tests untouched; summary.md delivered.
anchors.5: Minor deviations that do not change the result.
